agent_walkthrough._description: Step-by-step procedure for an AI agent or M2M (machine-to-machine) client to obtain, present, and revoke credentials against the Telnyx API. The full prose walkthrough lives at /auth.md; this inline block is the agent-discovery summary.

steps.name: Discover
steps.action: GET https://telnyx.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server to read this AS metadata document. Inspect the agent_auth block for register_uri / claim_uri / revocation_uri / auth_md. For the protected-resource metadata (resource server URLs, supported scopes), GET https://telnyx.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource.

steps.name: Pick a method
steps.action: Long-running agents with a stable account → Method 3 (Bearer API key, M2M / client_credentials). Multi-user agent platforms (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT extensions) → Method 4 (OAuth 2.0 + PKCE). One-off inference without signup → Method 5 (x402 pay-per-call on Base mainnet).

steps.name: Register / Mint a Bearer API key (bot-challenge signup, requires email)
steps.action: GET https://telnyx.com/agent-signup.md returns the obfuscated-math bot-challenge runbook. Steps in order: (1) POST https://api.telnyx.com/v2/bot_challenge to fetch the challenge. (2) Solve the challenge with the LLM agent. (3) POST https://api.telnyx.com/v2/bot_signup with the answer + email. A magic-link is then sent to that email — the agent (or human operator) must follow the magic-link to receive a temporary session token. (4) Use the session token as Bearer to POST https://api.telnyx.com/v2/api_keys, which mints the long-lived API key. End-to-end-autonomous only when the agent has programmatic email access; otherwise a human pastes the magic-link.
notes: Magic-link email step is currently the only path to obtain a session token after bot_signup.
Without email access the flow falls back to: user pastes the magic-link URL into the agent's prompt.
Full prose: see Step 4 (Path A / Path B) in /agent-signup.md.

steps.name: OR: OAuth 2.0 client_credentials (M2M with a pre-registered client)
steps.action: If you already have a registered OAuth client (registration_endpoint at https://portal.telnyx.com/oauth/register), use grant_type=client_credentials to mint a token in one round-trip. Form-encoded body: client_id, client_secret, grant_type=client_credentials. Returns access_token + token_type=Bearer + expires_in.

steps.name: OR: OAuth 2.0 authorization_code + PKCE — authorize (user-delegated)
steps.action: For a multi-user agent platform, redirect the user's browser to https://portal.telnyx.com/oauth/authorize with the query parameters below. The user signs in and consents; Telnyx redirects back to <redirect_uri> with ?code=<authorization_code>&state=<csrf>. This step is a browser redirect, not an API call — no request body. Then exchange the code at the token endpoint in step 3c.

steps.name: OR: OAuth 2.0 authorization_code + PKCE — token exchange
steps.action: Exchange the authorization code from step 3b for an access token. Telnyx's token endpoint advertises `client_secret_basic` and `client_secret_post` in `token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported`, so client authentication is REQUIRED in addition to PKCE — send client_id + client_secret either via HTTP Basic auth header (client_secret_basic) or in the form-encoded body (client_secret_post). PKCE alone is NOT sufficient; the client_secret is also required.

request_body_template.client_secret: {{your_client_secret — sent via Basic auth header (client_secret_basic) OR body (client_secret_post)}}

steps.name: Use the bearer credential
steps.action: Set `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on every request to https://api.telnyx.com/v2/* — covers Voice, Messaging, Numbers, Inference, MCP tools, and the agent-runtime surface. Token TTL for OAuth-issued tokens is `expires_in` from the token response; API keys do not expire until revoked.

steps.name: x402 pay-per-call (no registration, no Bearer token)
steps.action: For one-shot inference, POST to https://x402.telnyx.com/v1/chat/completions without auth. The server replies with HTTP 402 and a payment-required quote in the response header. Sign the quote (EIP-3009 USDC on Base mainnet) and retry with X-Payment: <signed-quote>. Discovery doc: https://telnyx.com/.well-known/x402.

steps.name: Refresh (OAuth only)
steps.action: POST https://api.telnyx.com/oauth/token with grant_type=refresh_token + refresh_token + client authentication. As with token exchange in step 3c, the token endpoint requires client_secret_basic (HTTP Basic header with client_id:client_secret) or client_secret_post (client_id + client_secret in the body) per token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported above — refresh is not available for clients without a secret. Bearer API keys (Method 3) do not refresh — they're long-lived until revoked.

request_body_template.client_secret: {{your_client_secret — sent via Basic auth header (client_secret_basic) OR body (client_secret_post)}}

steps.name: Revoke
steps.action: Bearer API keys: DELETE https://api.telnyx.com/v2/api_keys/{id} (or revoke from the portal). OAuth tokens: POST https://api.telnyx.com/oauth/revoke with token=<access_or_refresh_token>. Revocation is immediate; in-flight requests with the revoked credential return 401. Full prose: https://telnyx.com/auth.md#revocation.

401_invalid_token.meaning: Credential missing, malformed, expired, or revoked. Re-register at the agent_auth.register_uri above or refresh via grant_type=refresh_token.

401_insufficient_scope.meaning: Credential is valid but lacks the scope for this endpoint. Re-run the OAuth flow with the requested scope; for API keys, check account permissions.

402_payment_required.meaning: x402 endpoint requires payment; no auth was sent. Sign the quote and retry with X-Payment header.

429_rate_limited.meaning: Rate-limited. Honor RateLimit-Limit / RateLimit-Remaining / RateLimit-Reset response headers (RFC 9598) to self-throttle.
